models.name: Photo
models.description: RealPLKSR trained on web photography with realistic noise, lens blur and JPEG/WebP compression. Sharp, natural detail.
models.author: Philip Hofmann (Phhofm)

models.name: Anime & Art
models.tagline: Best quality for anime, cartoons and illustrations
models.description: RealPLKSR (DySample) trained on frames from modern anime films. Clean lines, no ringing, removes compression.
models.author: Philip Hofmann (Phhofm)

models.name: Fast
models.description: Compact network trained on mixed content with JPEG degradation. Roughly 25× faster than the quality models and, on our fidelity checks, more accurate than the larger SPAN variant it replaced.
models.author: Philip Hofmann (Phhofm)

models.name: Fast Anime
models.description: Compact anime upscaler trained on HFA2k with compression and blur degradations. Tiny and very fast.
models.author: Philip Hofmann (Phhofm)

tools.name: JPEG cleanup
tools.description: RealPLKSR (1x) trained to remove JPEG blocking and ringing. Runs before upscaling so the upscaler never mistakes compression blocks for detail.
tools.author: Philip Hofmann (Phhofm)

tools.name: Face detector
tools.description: YuNet, a tiny CNN face detector (about 230 KB) that also reports five facial landmarks, used to align faces for restoration.
tools.author: Shiqi Yu et al. (libfacedetection / OpenCV Zoo)

tools.name: Face restoration
tools.description: GFPGAN v1.4 (StyleGAN2 facial prior) rebuilds eyes, skin and hair on aligned 512 px face crops. Weights are stored in 8 bits to keep the download small.
tools.author: Tencent ARC Lab (Xintao Wang et al.)
